name: Reddio RedSonic Vault stETH double count via permissionless registerErc20
summary: The RedSonic Vault diamond prices its ETH share class from provider legs that read the vault's raw stETH balance, and anyone could register stETH as a separate share class whose assets are that same raw balance. The attacker registered stETH, bought nearly all rsvETH with flash-loaned ETH, deposited stETH to inflate rsvETH's backing without minting rsvETH, then redeemed rsvETH at the inflated rate and withdrew its stETH, draining the vault's native ETH.

loss.notes: Exact native-ETH depletion of the diamond in source-1 (balance before minus after). The attacker's deposited ETH and stETH are returned within the transaction and are not victim loss.

ageReset.description: DiamondCut Replace routing registerErc20, depositErc20, depositEth and share-token getters to facet 0x92ecc5de (data word 5); manualWithdraw was added to the same facet one block earlier. Last cut before the exploit.
Initial DiamondCut adding InvestmentManagerFacet (data word 58) with getTotalAssetBalance and getRemainingBalance; never recut.

limitations: Raw-balance pricing half of the double count (with its delegatecalled LidoProvider leg, created block 19958201); activated earlier than target-1's facet, so not the knot.

sources.note: Anchor and root cause. Source-1: status 1, block 25912201 index 138, ts 1788624191, CREATE by EOA 0x70f2333d21ed7e7d105f6578227a9a747687982c (created 0xaefa97ae3df32193ff18edcf477fec944f1435b3, which deploys executor 0x39a2aee44bd9ef106917d94880a9f8f7cfaf09d5). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): Balancer flash loan of 1139615952950658009506 wei WETH (log 276), unwrapped; executor calls diamond registerErc20 0xa4a3c9ef(stETH 0xae7ab96520de3a18e5e111b5eaab095312d7fe84), delegated to facet 0x92ecc5deacb14937867686ca8b85dd8a65b74704, which creates share token rsvstETH 0xf65e1ec6093642ba9d439ac25af1b767054e1558 (events 0x2e2b3f61 log 279, ERC20 registration 0xf9b652c1 log 280); depositEth 0x439370b1 with 1130.259297504314263299 ETH mints 1118002170814811445360 wei rsvETH 0xca9de1f80df74331c5fcb7eee2d05e746d47bfb2 (log 281); Lido submit 9356655446343746207 wei; depositErc20 0x6548b40d moves 9336655446343746204 wei stETH into the diamond (log 288) and mints rsvstETH (log 287). getTotalAssetBalance 0x13ef789e(ETH) (InvestmentManagerFacet 0x47f018dc00307cd48fd71d489d92e550646598de) = sum of provider legs + getRemainingBalance; its LidoProvider leg (DELEGATECALL 0x23310b0523843c290bbadaf0b8bbd321c3e39c62 selector 0x5373433f) reads stETH.balanceOf(diamond) and returns 762919233510916648 wei before and 10099574679854662852 wei in the redemption after the stETH deposit, so the same raw stETH is counted in the ETH class and, through getRemainingBalance(stETH), in the rsvstETH class. manualWithdraw 0x735fd189(rsvETH) then burns all attacker rsvETH and pays 1139.513928645387002525 ETH from the diamond; manualWithdraw(rsvstETH) returns 9336655446343746250 wei stETH (log 294); stETH is sold on Curve and the loan repaid; 9252513259589061442 wei goes to the EOA. registerErc20 succeeded for a contract created in the same transaction, so registration is permissionless. Earliest exercise: Etherscan V2 logs.getLogs on the diamond, blocks 0..99999999, paged by block (22995 logs, last at block 25993218); ERC20 registration topic 0xf9b652c16f9592f9f14353a739befc296a75e6b930ee497a499090bfb852ac72 occurs 4 times: USDT (block 19958213, owner 0xeb9e3b1303383f52fe4638532d8292df12ad08d5), 0x7122985656e38bdc0302db86685bb972b145bd3c (block 21062702, owner 0x3786540ec316f2383fab2d5cfc816c1abdfeef44), stETH in source-1, and WETH at 25962707 after the vault was emptied. vTokenFromErc20(stETH) returns 0 earlier in source-1, so stETH had never been registered and no earlier transaction could exercise the double count.

Loss. eth_getBalance(diamond) = 9254631141072742068 wei at block 25912200 and 2842 wei at 25912201; stETH.balanceOf(diamond) 48 -> 2 wei. In source-1 the diamond receives 1130.259297504314263299 ETH (depositEth) and pays 1139.513928645387002525 ETH (manualWithdraw rsvETH); stETH in (log 288) 9336655446343746204 wei and out (log 294) 9336655446343746250 wei (the extra 46 wei is the pre-existing stETH dust). Gross depletion of other rsvETH holders' native-ETH backing: 9254631141072739226 wei = 9.254631141072739226 ETH (46 wei stETH ignored). The attacker's own deposits are returned within the same transaction and not counted. The attacker nets 9252513259589061442 wei after Lido/Curve slippage. No later successful drain: the diamond holds 2842 wei afterwards.

InvestmentManagerFacet 0x47f018dc00307cd48fd71d489d92e550646598de: verified (Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode; v0.8.24+commit.e11b9ed9, optimizer off; SHA-256 of returned SourceCode 17748c68ab47caa714d475aa8df2a9b188f22d13be458e2e77e9dc54b6b5dfa2). getTotalAssetBalance(asset) sums getAssetBalance over providers() (delegatecall to each provider) plus getRemainingBalance(asset) = IERC20(asset).balanceOf(this) for tokens. Created top-level by 0xeb9e3b13... in 0xd9b6d841d2fecf24f1f0e5ed2b09f9f7bd174d52200b3a3df2925c162b137e4d (block 19958068 index 84); eth_getCode empty at 19958067; keccak runtime (16621 bytes) 0x612437574dde5c8f68ec3adb11a31237b5afbd849f0fb65f0beb72aa96aa3bc0 at 19958068 and 25912200. Routed by DiamondCut 0x659c0bb15f4454ef61b894e1aebc9117796635298f5b28959c46586f6181c532 (block 19958068 index 85 log 157, facet address in data word 58, Add of 36 selectors incl. 0x13ef789e, 0x001bf8f6, 0xb0549676); no later cut touches it. The ETH-class Lido leg is LidoProvider 0x23310b0523843c290bbadaf0b8bbd321c3e39c62 (verified LidoProvider, created block 19958201), reached by DELEGATECALL.

Identity and age. Diamond 0x4315990d9eeaffdfafd49958b4851f203fa1126f (verified Diamond, runtime 538 bytes, keccak 0xbad9f477142c7182dd831ce7b2ccee1156e5f6662f147ec27a04c6fb286930f2 at 19958065 and 25912200; empty at 19958064) created top-level by 0xeb9e3b1303383f52fe4638532d8292df12ad08d5 in source-4 (block 19958065 index 60); owner at 25912200 is 0x3786540ec316f2383fab2d5cfc816c1abdfeef44. Etherscan getLogs DiamondCut topic 0x8faa7087... on the diamond, blocks 0..99999999, returns 10 events; decoded: facet 0x92ecc5deacb14937867686ca8b85dd8a65b74704 Add 0x735fd189 (manualWithdraw) at block 21936325 index 101 log 187, then Replace of 19 selectors incl. 0xa4a3c9ef registerErc20, 0x6548b40d depositErc20, 0x439370b1 depositEth, 0xac749536, 0x95ce754c in source-5 (block 21936326 index 83 log 272, ts 1740643115, facet address in data word 5); no later cut exists. facetAddress(bytes4) at block 25912200 returns 0x92ecc5de... for 0xa4a3c9ef/0x6548b40d/0x439370b1/0x735fd189 and 0x47f018dc... for 0x13ef789e/0x001bf8f6. Facet 0x92ecc5de created top-level by owner 0x3786540e in 0x76c480f45f3b3f419eb4ad78bf48192e8a152f31f562ee30e4072e24fd4ff912 (block 21936323 index 229); eth_getCode empty at 21936322; keccak runtime (14023 bytes) 0xf13cf4ce0234309c6721f3095a8647fad9dfc125a2e136f49b580ca0b726e20a at 21936323 and 25912200. The facet is unverified; its permissionless registerErc20 and the redemption that pays from double-counted totals are established from the source-1 trace. Its activation at log 272 is the latest code change in the exploited path, so age = 1788624191 - 1740643115 = 47981076 s (1.52 years). Other diamond events after 21936326 are deposits/withdrawals, share-token events and Lido stake/unstake records (0x0d34deca, 0xfa39b4ac, 0xaddfb37e); ERC20 registrations are listed in source-3; none changes routing or the counted stETH provider.
